about_short_description.short_description: Alephee helps automotive aftermarket brands to supply and sell parts online offering a supplier portal and integration to marketplaces

product.name: Alephee Platform
product.description: A digital platform connecting automotive aftermarket brands, manufacturers, wholesalers, retailers, and service providers to manage and coordinate their business strategies and sales processes.

product.name: Business Social Network
product.description: A commercial social network for automotive industry participants to connect, interact, and develop business relationships within the aftermarket sector.

product.name: B2B Supply Solutions
product.description: Solutions to manage and streamline the supply chain for automotive aftermarket products, ensuring reliable flow of goods and materials.

product.name: Digital Sales Enhancement
product.description: Dashboard and analytics tools to support retailers in increasing digital sales through insights and performance metrics.

product.name: Marketplace Integration
product.description: Integration services that automate sales processes by connecting automotive aftermarket products to major e-commerce platforms like Mercado Libre, Amazon, and Shopee.
